title: Listener dedupe keys on transaction id only, so the second document event of a multi-document transaction is dropped
failureClass: listener dedupe drops a real event (pair stops receiving listener events)
source: Listener ordering and dedupe hotspot in 02-surface.md (sequentializeListenerEvents, dedupe); fuzz bypass list in 05-radar-fuzz.md
userVisibleEffect: Publish (one transaction touching drafts.x and x) delivers only the first of the two events; getPairListener waits for the missing one, so every later listener event for the pair is held and the pane keeps showing the pre-publish state
